title: Contacts in Lieu of Glasses on Vision Plans Out-of-Network Claims (Glasses Part)
content:
**Benefit interpretation bulletin — Vision Plans**

Contacts-in-lieu settles the materials of an out-of-network claim settled on its glasses part in this order:

1. When a spectacle-lens or frame service of the same person counts in the claim's benefit period, the claim's contact-lens line and its fitting line are not reimbursed.
2. Otherwise, when a contact-lens service of the same person counts there, the claim's spectacle-lens and frame lines are not reimbursed.
3. Otherwise, when the claim carries contact lenses and spectacle lenses or a frame, only the larger of two parts is reimbursed, the glasses part on a tie. The two parts are the contact-lens part (the contact-lens line together with the fitting line) and the glasses part (the spectacle-lens and frame lines).
4. Otherwise, every line is reimbursed under its own amount.

A line left out this way is denied as contacts in lieu of glasses.

**When a service of the other kind counts.** It counts when it is the latest service of its kind of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, and its date of service falls in the same benefit period as the service settled, whatever its order against it. Spectacle lenses, frames and contact lenses are each a kind of their own. When that latest one is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none of that kind and no earlier one is looked at; of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing. A benefit period is the twelve-month period that starts each year on the enrollment's benefit-period reset day, and a latest service dated in another benefit period counts nothing.

| Earlier service counting in the period | Claim carries | Reimbursed materials |
|---|---|---|
| Spectacle lenses or frame | Anything | Glasses part only; contact-lens and fitting lines left out |
| Contact lenses only | Anything | Contact-lens part only; spectacle-lens and frame lines left out |
| None | Contact lenses and glasses | The larger part; the glasses part on a tie |
| None | Only one side | Every line under its own amount |

*Hypothetical comparison.* Nothing counts in the period. The claim's glasses lines come to 93.40 and its contact-lens line with fitting to 93.40. The tie goes to the glasses part, and the contact-lens and fitting lines are denied as contacts in lieu of glasses.
